change: Parquet #3638, page writer reuse and persisted row groups
deployment: Two pinned production writer classes over Parquet 1.18.2, the Hadoop file graph and unshaded fastutil. File fixture uses local streams.
assumptions: Fresh local file per JVM, uncompressed required UTF-8 binary column, exactly 1000 rows per group, V1 pages, dictionary threshold 10000 bytes.

questions.observer: Decode all 1000 second-group values after reusing the same writer. Record first/second encoding, dictionary contents, first and last decoded values and match count.
questions.basis: The first group contains a0 through a999 and the second repeats c0 through c9. A stale plain prefix is distinguishable from the expected second group.

questions.observer: Decode a fresh writer and a reused writer after a group below the fallback threshold.
questions.basis: The fresh writer has no preceding state. The low-cardinality first group is dictionary friendly on both releases.

questions.observer: Write two 1000-row groups, close, reopen with independent page and record readers, check the row boundaries, dictionary contents, encodings and every decoded string.
questions.basis: The public file writer creates a new column store after flushing a row group. The first group may fall back but that writer is not reused for the second.
